messages.author: c4390b997ff96dbb
messages.subject: export map file
parts:
Hello,

I have mapped the 9 largest linkage groups and now want to export the linkage map for use in qtl analyses.

Do I need to run:

All_q50C50trim <- orderMarkers(All_q50C50trim, chr=c(1:9))

as this is computationally intensive?

Also, I am getting error messages for the line:

write.cross(All_q50C50trim, "qltcart", "/afs/crc.nd.edu/user/r/rengel/R", chr=c(1:9))

It says the write.cross needs a cross object

 

##exportData

##export data as map file

library(qtl)

All_q50C50 <- read.cross("csvr", ".", "All_q50C50copy2a.csv", estimate.map=FALSE)

#removes 4 ind

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [ , -c( 8, 35, 37, 90)]

summary(All_q50C50)

#remove dis seg markers

gt <- geno.table(All_q50C50)

gt[gt$P.value < 0.05/totmar(All_q50C50),]

todrop<- rownames(gt[gt$P.value < 1e-10,])

All_q50C50trim <- drop.markers(All_q50C50, todrop)

summary(All_q50C50trim)

All_q50C50trim <- est.rf(All_q50C50trim)

#check if alleles switched

checkAlleles(All_q50C50trim, threshold=5)

#form LG, earlier tested and found these parameters gave balance b/t no. of LG and no. markers per LG

All_q50C50trim <- formLinkageGroups(All_q50C50trim, max.rf=0.35, min.lod=8, reorgMarkers=TRUE)

All_q50C50trim <- orderMarkers(All_q50C50trim, chr=c(1:9))

#script below from book p33, trying to export a map file for LG1-9 that can be used for qtl analyses

write.cross(All_q50C50trim, "qltcart", "/afs/crc.nd.edu/user/r/rengel/R", chr=c(1:9))

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] export map file
parts:
If you want to order the markers, then yes you would need to run orderMarkers. formLinkageGroups() leaves the markers in an essentially arbitrary order, which would not be useful for QTL mapping.

The intensive parts are
(a) using ripple() repeatedly
(b) estimate the genetic map

You can speed up (a) by either skipping that part (use.ripple=FALSE) or using a different window size (window=2 or 3 rather than window=7).

You can speed up (b) by not running the algorithm to convergence (use maxit=6 rather than maxit=4000). You'd want to follow up with est.map() and replace.map(), so that the final map is estimated as well as possible.

I don't see anything wrong in your code that would give that error from write.cross.
What do you get when you type

summary(All_q50C50trim)
class(All_q50C50trim)

karl
